title: Wilting Weeping Willow
description: You discover a great tree that resembles a wilting waterfall. What secrets lie here?

mainQuestExcel.title: Wilting Weeping Willow
mainQuestExcel.description: You discover a great tree that resembles a wilting waterfall. What secrets lie here?

flow.stepDescription: Search for the "key" near the "Weeping Willow"

dialogs.text: (Most of the inscription has been scratched out, but you can make out "...foam...")
What does that mean? It must be crucial to finding the key, right? Guess we need to figure out how to activate this altar...

flow.stepDescription: Find a way to activate the altar
Examine the item on the altar
Examine the item on the altar

dialogs.text: A glittering pearl of water appears on the altar.
Um, that drop of water... That can't be the treasure, can it?
It doesn't look like treasure.
That's what Paimon thought. It can't be that easy. But what is it, then?
Maybe it is key to containing the Demon King.
Maybe someone else put it here.
What? But that means catastrophe! Quick, put it back. Paimon hopes we're not too late!
Ah...
Oh no! It's the Demon King!
The Demon King? Melusine.
What? Oh no, that makes us thieves. Ohh, Paimon's sorry... Let's put it back, quick.
Ah...
Oh no! The boss is back!
The boss? Melusine.
Gah, you gave Paimon a fright there... A Melusine, huh? What are you doing here?
Key.
Key? What key? Is this drop of water a key?
Pahsiv.
Err... The drop of water is Pahsiv?
Melusine.
Ugh! What do you mean? Is the drop of water a Melusine? Paimon's getting dizzy. What on earth is this? Aren't you the Melusine here?
Pahsiv...
Err... You're a Pahsiv? Or is your name Pahsiv? Wait... No, don't answer. You'll just make Paimon dizzier...
Anyway, Paimon's decided to call you Pahsiv. Is that okay?
Melusine...
#{NICKNAME}... What should we do? Paimon can't understand a thing she's saying. What is she trying to say?
You can understand what we're saying, can't you?
Pahsiv...
This drop of water is a key, right?
Pahsiv.
You're not a human, are you?
Pahsiv!
Er... Let's not be rude all of a sudden, shall we?
I'm not a human, am I?
M—Melusine?
Oh! Wait! Paimon thinks she's starting to understand. "Pahsiv" is yes and "Melusine" is no. Could that be it?
Pahsiv! Pahsiv!
So you're not called Pahsiv. Sorry, Paimon got your name wrong earlier.
Pahsiv... likes...
You like the name?
Pahsiv!
#Wonderful! Then that's what Paimon's gonna call you, hehe. This is {NICKNAME}. We're glad to meet you, Pahsiv. Paimon's never met a Melusine like you.
#Paimon, Pahsiv! {NICKNAME}, Pahsiv!
Erinnyes... Melusine...
...So you mean Erinn-no? Or... Err...
Something wrong with Erinnyes?
Erinnyes, Melusine, now...
Pahsiv, Erinnyes, protect...
So, something bad is happening to Erinnyes, and you want to protect it?
#Paimon, {NICKNAME}, Erinnyes, ka-pow, ka-pow...
#Err... So that's five words now. So... you want Paimon and {NICKNAME} to punch Erinnyes? Like KA-POW?
Melusine!
You want us to help?
Pahsiv!
Okay, so she wants help from us. That's good. Paimon didn't know how we could punch Erinnyes, with it being a whole island and all...
Ka-pow, ka-pow.
Will there be any rewards?
What do we need to do?
Re... ward?
#Oh come on, {NICKNAME}! Pahsiv can barely talk! She won't be able to find anyone else to help her, so we should just do it!
What do we need to do?
Key, key, key, number.
And then? How many keys is that, now?
Key! Key! Key!
Three keys?
Pahsiv! Key, foggy path, south...
Key, spring, north...
Key, willow, east...
Oh, that's what you mean... Let's make a note real quick... Three keys in total, one in the southern foggy road, one in the northern spring, and one in the eastern willows... Is Paimon right?
Key, key, key, square, west.
And there are three keys in the square to the west?
Collect three keys and go to the square?
#Paimon, Melusine! {NICKNAME}, Pahsiv!
#Oh c'mon, Pahsiv, do you have to always make it sound like {NICKNAME} is cleverer than Paimon? We're clearly of more or less equal intellect!
Anyway, we've already got one key, so all we need to do is find the remaining two.
Erinnyes, Melusine... Pahsiv, protect!
Relax. Paimon doesn't know what's happened, but we're going to help you protect Erinnyes for sure.
But if Paimon could add one small point, Pahsiv, Paimon would like to say that if you happen to see anything shiny, round, and unwanted, or some expensive-looking chest...
Well, it would be just wonderful if you could let us know!
Pahsiv scratches her head as she tries to understand, then gives two more happy jumps and leaves in a bit of a hurry.
#Oh, she ran straight off. Guess she must have something really urgent to work on. {NICKNAME}, shall we go looking for those two keys now?
A glittering pearl of water appears on the altar.
Awesome! Now, we have the third key.
Key, key, key!
Disappeared, Pahsiv!
#Paimon, Pahsiv! {NICKNAME}, Pahsiv! Key, key, key!
Square, west!
Hehe. Is this what you're trying to say? Don't worry, we're going there now.
And that's another key for us. Now all we need to do is find the final one.
Key, key, Pahsiv!
Oh, Pahsiv! Where did you come from?
Disappeared, Pahsiv.
Okay then... Paimon's never met a Melusine so unique... And Paimon thought Melusine all lived in the Court of Fontaine or Merusea Village. How come you're out here?
Court of Fontaine? Merusea Village?
You seem confused. Haven't you heard of those places?
Court of Fontaine, Melusine... Merusea Village, Melusine...
Ah... Erinnyes, Pahsiv, home.
Erinnyes, Pahsiv, protect!
Wait, you're saying that this is your home? And that you're protecting it?
Pahsiv!
But don't the Melusine live in Merusea Village?
Yes, that's kinda strange. Are some Melusine born elsewhere? Paimon can't see any others here though.
Pahsiv, do you live here alone?
Alone? Melusine. New Valet! Pahsiv!
New... Valet? There's a valet? Who?
#New... Valet! Paimon, Paimon, {NICKNAME}, {NICKNAME}. New Valet, New Valet!
So who is New Valet, exactly?
Pahsiv... are you trying to say New Valet is called New Valet, like Paimon is called Paimon?
Pahsiv!
Ah-ha! I was right. Paimon's always said that she's clever, hasn't she?
It's a very strange name.
New Valet, Pahsiv, knowledge, ka-pow.
Err... you mean that New Valet is helping you learn things?
Pahsiv! Lots of. Language, wisdom... lots of.
Er, Paimon's not sure about the "lots of" bit...
Pahsiv, New Valet, protect, ka-pow.
And he helps you protect this place?
Melusine...
You help him protect this place?
Pahsiv!
So that's it... But who is this New Valet? And why does he need you to help protect this place, anyway?
And some really bad things have happened here, too. We saw the stone tablet and how someone had scratched out the inscription, and lots of filth... Are there any enemies?
Curious Paimon, Pahsiv! But time very not lots of.
Key, key, key, square, west, ka-pow, ka-pow.
We'll be as quick as we can!
#Paimon, Pahsiv! {NICKNAME}, Pahsiv!
Pahsiv gives two happy jumps and then leaves in a bit of a hurry.
It looks like we really are pressed for time. But we've already got two keys, so let's press on and get the third!
That's an awesome name.

Remove the filth from the Dewfoam Flower
